hello.what: The welcome picture of an exercise app: the clay figure saying hello.
hello.view: Seen from the front at a slight three-quarter angle, the figure facing the camera.
frames: standing relaxed and happy, one hand raised beside the head in a friendly wave, the other arm by the side; weight on one leg, a small cheerful tilt of the head.

off_to_train.what: Moving every day is part of a normal day: the clay figure setting off to the gym, light and glad, as ordinary as going to breakfast.
off_to_train.view: Seen exactly from the side, the figure facing and walking to the right.
frames: walking along mid-stride with an easy, happy step, a small black clay gym bag held in one hand, the other arm swinging naturally; a white clay sweatband round one wrist.
off_to_train.props: a small black clay gym bag and a white clay sweatband

eat.what: An ordinary morning: the clay figure eating breakfast.
eat.view: Seen from the side and a little in front, the figure facing to the right.
frames: sitting on a small clay stool at a small round clay table, happily eating from a bowl with a spoon raised to the mouth.
eat.props: a small round light-wood clay table, a small clay stool, a white clay bowl and a spoon

sleep.what: An ordinary night: the clay figure fast asleep.
sleep.view: Seen from the side and a little above.
frames: lying asleep on its back in a small clay bed, eyes closed as two little curved lines, a content smile, a soft blanket pulled up to the chest, head on a pillow.
sleep.props: a small simple clay bed with a light grey blanket and a white pillow

stretch_up.what: Feeling good: the clay figure stretching after waking, glad to move.
stretch_up.view: Seen from the front at a slight three-quarter angle.
frames: standing tall, both arms stretched straight up overhead, up on the toes a little, eyes happily closed, a big smile.

gym_lost.what: Walking into a gym and not knowing what to do, as if nobody ever showed you; then opening the app, and the relief of being shown.
gym_lost.view: Seen from the front at three-quarters, a little wider so some of the gym shows.
frames: standing still between gym machines, one hand scratching the side of the head, looking around unsure, a small puzzled mouth instead of a smile.

the same spot, still a little unsure, the hand now down from the head, taking a small black clay phone out and holding it up in both hands at chest height, looking at it hopefully, a small unsure mouth.
the same, holding the small black clay phone in both hands at chest height and looking down at the screen, the face relaxing into a small, relieved smile, shoulders a little lower and softer.
gym_lost.props: a few simple clay gym things around and behind the figure: a dumbbell rack with a few black dumbbells, a cable machine and a flat bench, all in matte grey and black clay, kept simple; from the second moment on, a small black clay phone in the hands

guess.what: Guessing at the gym: trying something at random, unsure if it's right.
guess.view: Seen from the front at a slight three-quarter angle.
frames: holding a black clay dumbbell in one hand at an odd angle and looking at it doubtfully, the other hand open in a shrug, a small unsure mouth.

sofa.what: Giving up: the clay figure at home on the sofa instead of going to the gym.
sofa.view: Seen from the side and a little in front, the figure facing to the right.
frames: slumped low on a small clay sofa, arms limp, a flat bored mouth; the gym bag lies unopened on the floor beside the sofa.
sofa.props: a small simple grey clay sofa and the small black clay gym bag on the floor

phone.what: At the gym, the clay figure checks its phone and knows exactly what to do.
phone.view: Seen from the side and a little in front, the figure facing to the right.
frames: standing in the gym holding a small black clay phone in one hand, looking at it with a confident smile, a black clay dumbbell in the other hand.
phone.props: a small black clay phone and one black clay dumbbell; behind, kept soft and simple, a grey clay dumbbell rack

curl.what: Doing a little, every day: the clay figure lifting with slow, good form.
curl.view: Seen from the side and a little in front, the figure facing to the right.
frames: standing tall doing a dumbbell curl, the elbow tucked at the side, the black clay dumbbell raised to the shoulder, a calm focused smile.

shaped.what: Small days add up: the same clay figure some months on, a bit stronger.
shaped.view: Seen from the front at a slight three-quarter angle.
frames: standing tall and proud, hands on hips, chest open; the same figure but a little sturdier, with slightly fuller shoulders, arms and legs, as if a little more clay had been added and smoothed; a big warm smile.

body_hello.what: The figure is the viewer's own body, saying hello to them, a little shy and warm.
body_hello.view: Seen straight from the front, the figure looking right into the camera.
frames: standing relaxed, arms by the sides, looking straight at the viewer with a small, warm, slightly shy smile.
the same, now giving a small friendly wave with one hand at shoulder height, head tilted a little.

young_climb.what: Remembering childhood: moving was a game. The figure as a small child, climbing just for fun.
young_climb.view: Seen from the front at a slight three-quarter angle, a little wider.
frames: a smaller, younger, rounder version of the same figure (child proportions, same clay, in a sweater) climbing a simple clay climbing frame, one hand reaching up for the next bar, one foot on a lower bar, a big happy open smile.

the same child one step higher on the frame, the other hand reaching up now, the other foot lifted, still smiling. The climbing frame stays exactly where it is in the first picture: same position, size and angle; only the child moves.
young_climb.props: a simple light-wood clay climbing frame, like a small playground ladder
young_climb.wears: a soft, chunky knitted clay sweater in a muted pastel blue, long sleeves to the wrists, over the black shorts

young_run.what: Remembering childhood: running for no reason, pure joy.
young_run.view: Seen exactly from the side, the figure facing to the right.
frames: a smaller, younger, rounder version of the same figure (child proportions, same clay, in a sweater) running happily, mid-stride, both feet off the ground, arms swinging, a big open laughing mouth.

the same child in the OPPOSITE stride: now the other leg is forward and the first leg is stretched back, and the arms have swapped too (the arm that was forward is now back), so the two pictures clearly alternate like a run cycle; both feet off the ground, still laughing, same place and size.
young_run.wears: a soft, chunky knitted clay sweater in a muted pastel blue, long sleeves to the wrists, over the black shorts

young_hang.what: Remembering childhood: hanging upside down until dinner.
young_hang.view: Seen from the side and a little in front.
frames: a smaller, younger, rounder version of the same figure (child proportions, same clay, in a sweater) hanging upside down by the backs of the knees from a low clay bar, arms dangling down loosely, laughing with a wide-open round mouth (an open laughing O), which reads as happy from any angle; the eyes and mouth are upside down together with the head.

the same child, still hanging by the knees in exactly the same place, now swinging a little, arms spread wide, still laughing with the same open mouth; the face stays upside down with the head exactly as in the first picture.
young_hang.props: one simple low light-wood clay bar on two posts
young_hang.wears: a soft, chunky knitted clay sweater in a muted pastel blue, long sleeves to the wrists, over the black shorts

sit.what: Grown up: the figure mostly sits now, and its soft clay body slowly takes the shape of the sofa.
sit.view: Seen from the side and a little in front, the figure facing to the right.
frames: sitting on a small simple grey clay sofa, a bit slumped, shoulders rounded, hands in the lap, a flat bored mouth.

the same, but sunk right down into the armchair: the soft clay body has slumped and settled into the cushion like soft dough, back curved deep like a C, shoulders melted forward, the belly and seat squashed and spread into the shape of the seat so it's hard to see where the figure ends and the cushion begins; head drooping, a tired flat mouth. The armchair stays exactly where it is.
sit.props: a small simple grey clay sofa

get_up.what: The body wants to move again: the figure gets up off the sofa and stretches.
get_up.view: Seen from the side and a little in front, the figure facing to the right.
frames: standing up from the small grey clay sofa, halfway up, hands pushing on the knees, looking ahead with a small hopeful smile.
standing tall in front of the sofa, both arms stretched straight up overhead, up on the toes a little, eyes happily closed, a big smile.
get_up.props: a small simple grey clay sofa

walk_home.what: After the workout: walking home feeling light and warm, standing a little taller.
walk_home.view: Seen exactly from the side, the figure facing to the right.
frames: walking along mid-stride, easy and light, chest open, standing tall, a small black clay gym bag over one shoulder, a quiet happy smile, eyes half closed as if feeling the cool air.
the same, in the opposite stride, a little bounce in the step.
walk_home.props: a small black clay gym bag
